findings.title: Divisor includes rows the filter discarded
findings.detail: seen[row['site']] is incremented before the is_usable() guard, so the denominator counts suspect readings that never contributed to totals[]. Every site containing at least one suspect row reports an average below the true value. Sites where all rows are suspect divide by a non-zero seen count against a zero total, silently reporting 0.0 rather than raising.

findings.title: float() conversion is unguarded
findings.detail: is_usable() only checks for an empty string. A non-numeric value such as 'n/a' passes the guard and raises ValueError inside site_averages(), aborting the whole nightly run rather than skipping one reading.

findings.title: Hardcoded filenames
findings.detail: main() hardcodes raw_meters.csv and dashboard.csv relative to the working directory, so the job breaks if cron runs it from anywhere other than /opt/rollup.

findings.title: Flag set is undocumented
findings.detail: The meaning of 'E', 'X' and '?' is not recorded anywhere in the module.
